CustomField.label: API Token
CustomField.description: Your Veleiro API token (Bearer). Stored as data, never in source code. This is the only value you must enter to connect. Needs task:write (plus client and project read).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Paste your Veleiro API token here (it starts with vlr_). Get it from your Veleiro account under API / developer settings, with write access to tasks and read access to clients and projects. This is the only required value.
